description: a strong woman lady of the beasts with long light brown hair, a huge white wolf pelt worn as a hooded mantle with the white wolf's head over her head and two large brown antlers rising from it, brown leather armour overgrown with green moss and small white flowers, a necklace of white fangs, fur-trimmed bracers, brown trousers and fur-topped boots, a calm young woman's face in clean profile with one eye, no bow and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the tips of the antlers to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look in detail: face, hair, wolf pelt hood with antlers, armour, moss, flowers and colours; the hands empty, without the antler bow and the spirit wolf
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
